QUOTE: The high-level part is `ret & 0xFF80`. It goes to `mbedtls_high_level_strerr()`... The low-level part is `ret & ~0xFF80`. If non-zero, it is appended after `" : "` with `mbedtls_low_level_strerr()`... `"X509 - ... : ASN1 - ..."` for a combined code.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a code splits into high-level and low-level parts and that both are rendered, joined with " : ", when both are present.
